name: path
purpose: A line in a scene, drawn as a thin tube: through points, round a circle, or through a state list. With grow it draws part of its length.
binds: pts, circle, about, grow: numbers or state keys; of: a state list of [x, y, z]

id.doc: the path id; a body with along, and a drift, name it

pts.doc: the points [x, y, z] that the line goes through; an item can be a state key

circle.doc: a circle of this radius round about, in the plane across axis

axis.doc: with circle: the direction across the plane of the circle; [0, 1, 0] if left out, a flat circle

of.doc: the state key of a list of points, each [x, y, z] or {x, y, z}

closed.doc: with pts: join the last point to the first

smooth.doc: with pts: round the corners into a curve

grow.doc: the share of the length that shows, 0 to 1; a slider can walk the path

width.doc: the thickness, in units of a thin line

arrow.doc: an arrow head at the end

opacity.doc: how solid the line is; 1 if left out

show.doc: a state key; the path shows when its value is true

step.doc: the path shows from this step of the scene
